value.rationale: The degree of the edge equilibrium polynomial rises with group size N, so a uniform three-root bound is a substantive structural limit on model complexity, not a finite census. The exact N=4 three-root witness shows the sharp bound and an attracting root despite the numerical two-root diagrams in the motivating work; the single-attractor theorem limits possible distinct protective coexistence regimes. These facts matter for phase diagrams of quorum-protection policy and are not supplied by general Bernstein theory without new model coefficient analysis.
